parsed.why: Protective framework: administrative gender change, gender identity in anti-discrimination law, trans-specific health decree. Weaknesses are incomplete bias-crime enforcement and undenominated incident counts, with no documented traveller-facing restriction.

No trans-specific criminal exposure, and hate-speech law covers gender identity. Offset by documented hostility, violence against a visible trans-adjacent figure, prosecutors downgrading hate charges, and no working self-ID route. Partnership law is resident-facing.

No gender-identity anti-discrimination law and no marker procedure, but no facility restriction or trans criminal offence documented. Head of state's hostile remarks are official posture. Thin, partly dated evidence; marriage open since 2025.

Criminalises same-sex conduct with enforcement: raids, warrantless searches, police outing, detention abuse. Documented deportation of a trans woman to a men's prison with abuse. No recognition, no hate-crime cover, and incitement with physical attacks.

Self-determination law with X marker, hate-crime cover for gender identity, bathroom access protected, and conversion therapy banned. Official complaints routes exist. Low recorded hate-crime counts. Regional gay-scene gaps are not trans exposure.
